title: fix: report canonical text model IDs in x-model-used
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Reports the successful text candidate's canonical registry ID in `x-model-used` for static models, aliases, community models, and fallbacks.
- Applies the header consistently to streaming and non-streaming responses while leaving JSON `response.model` and SSE chunk model names provider-reported.
- Intentionally separates this header behavior change from the model-consolidation PR (#13043) so its purpose and history remain clear.

## Root cause

Normal static primary models withheld the resolved registry ID, so non-streaming headers fell back to the provider's model name and static streams lacked the canonical header. Existing tracking consumes this header.

## Validation

- `npx vitest run test/generation-vcr.test.ts test/tracking-observability.test.ts`
- Focused community, streaming, and fallback tests in `src/community-endpoints.test.ts`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npx biome check --write gen.pollinations.ai/src/text/handler.ts gen.pollinations.ai/test/generation-vcr.test.ts`

gist.headline: Names, properly labeled
gist.blurb: The hive’s model labels now follow the same trail as the request. `x-model-used` reports the canonical registry ID that actually won, even when aliases, community models, or fallbacks get involved.

gist.impact: Apps and tracking tools can now reliably identify the resolved Pollinations text model from `x-model-used`, including when a request takes an alias, community-model, or fallback route.
